title: Epic: open-fp vertical force plate integration (file and network boundary)
body:
## Summary

Integrate [open-flight/open-fp](https://github.com/open-flight/open-fp), an open-source pair of golf force plates (per-foot vertical force, per-foot and combined centre of pressure, lead/trail %, force events, 200 Hz), as a **vertical-only ground reaction data source**.

Plan: `docs/plans/open_fp_integration/` (README, ARCHITECTURE, BACKLOG), reviewed against open-fp commit `53d682ce70b34bd2d85918b210ebdc81937e33f8`.

## Hard Limits

1. **AGPL-3.0**: no vendoring, importing, depending on or copying open-fp code. Integrate only through its documented files (`<id>.json` + `<id>.npz`, CSV) and its network API, with independently written readers. Owner to confirm this boundary.
2. **Vertical force only**: shear and free moment are unobserved and must be NaN with an observability mask, never zero.
3. **Hardware not yet qualified** (open-fp M4/M6 pending): imported data is unqualified measurement until a device record passes the M4 checks (deferred validation).

## Proposed Children (not yet filed)

- OF-00 Upstream request: schema version, absolute `t[0]` time anchor, geometry snapshot, calibration id
- OF-01 `VerticalPlateTrial` contract and conversion to `GroundReactionSeries`
- OF-02 open-fp file reader (json + npz, csv)
- OF-03 Stance-to-model frame and handedness mapping
- OF-04 Force-event namespace in ground reaction plots
- OF-05 Plate trial time alignment with uncertainty
- OF-06 Read-only LAN client
- OF-07 Ground reaction tile import and overlay (feature parity entry)
- OF-08 Model-versus-measured vertical comparison metrics
- OF-09 Live Socket.IO bridge to realtime IPC (optional extra)
- OF-10 Research: measured vertical wrench in contact-wrench QP
- OF-HW Qualified device record (deferred validation)

See BACKLOG.md for dependencies and acceptance criteria.
